name: skill_manage
description: Create, update, or delete skills — your procedural memory for recurring task types. The call is an operations array (a single edit is a list of one); it applies atomically — any failure rolls every touched skill back. Ops: create (full SKILL.md; when a shared skills tree exists it lands in the profile home's skills-shared/<category>/ directory by default — git-backed + shared across agents, so `category` must be a real shared group; pass local=true for a single-agent skill in the profile's skills directory or configured skills.create_dir; create must precede that skill's other ops), patch (targeted old_string/new_string fix — preferred; content alone REPLACES the whole file, read it via skill_view() first), write_file/remove_file (supporting files), delete (sole op only). Existing skills are modified wherever they live. Keep the description's first 57 chars a self-contained trigger: 'Use when <trigger>. <one-line behavior>.' Write lessons, not logs: imperative rule + why, no PR numbers/dates/incident narration, one rule per lesson, references/ named by topic (extend before adding). skill_view() shows format conventions.

operations.description: Ordered ops; each names its target skill (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Each action is its own shape; another action's text slot is invalid.

content.description: Full SKILL.md text (YAML frontmatter + markdown body).

category.description: The skill's group/domain (e.g. 'devops'). When authoring into the shared tree (the default when one exists) this MUST be a real shared group (skills-shared/<group>/); with local=true it is an optional local subdirectory.

local.description: Default false: when a shared skills tree exists, new skills are authored into skills-shared/<category>/ (git-backed, shared across agents). Set true ONLY for a genuine single-agent skill in the local (gitignored, not-backed-up) tree.

old_string.description: Text to find (same matching semantics as the patch tool).

new_string.description: Replacement; empty string deletes the match.

file_path.description: Optional supporting file (write_file's shape); default SKILL.md.

content.description: Full SKILL.md rewrite (REPLACES the whole file; last resort).

file_path.description: Path RELATIVE to the skill's own directory, e.g. 'references/api.md' — no leading slash, never absolute; first segment references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/.

file_content.description: Full text of the supporting file.

absorbed_into.description: Curator consolidation only: umbrella skill that absorbed this one (must exist).
